Definition: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty), to celebrate (with praises)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to beautify; 1a) (Hiphil) to beautify, adorn; 2) to dwell; 2a) (Qal) to dwell, abide, keep at home; 3) (Hophal) rest
